terms.label: Asset
terms.definition: Runtime identity for an integrated resource.
terms.note: Not every runtime asset is physical; e.g. an FMS service.

terms.label: Capability
terms.definition: Declared supported operation with parameters and constraints.
terms.note: Support does not confer command authority.

terms.label: Task
terms.definition: Requested operational outcome with owner and lifecycle.

terms.label: Action
terms.definition: Bounded requested operation contributing to a task.

terms.label: Event
terms.definition: Timestamped occurrence attributed to a source.

terms.label: Observation
terms.definition: Value plus time, source, quality and mapping provenance.

terms.label: Alarm
terms.definition: Condition requiring attention with explicit severity and lifecycle.

terms.label: Location
terms.definition: Named place or coordinate frame; not an equipment role.

terms.label: Command authority
terms.definition: Explicit assignment of the system allowed to request an operation.

terms.label: State
terms.definition: Observed condition in a named dimension.
terms.note: Connectivity, execution, mode and safety remain separate.
